reopen_policy: After a demonstrated methodological defect, stop the affected formal attempt, preserve all artifacts and classify the attempt explicitly. A replacement confirmatory attempt may begin only after the defect is repaired, all affected evaluation contracts are re-frozen, the final DEVELOPMENT artifact is re-frozen, and a fresh isolated formal environment passes pre-run gates. Prior formal observations may not be relabelled as confirmatory evidence.
reporting_guardrails: Use 'recuperación híbrida con expansión de grafo gobernada' when describing the implemented M3 mechanism.
Model-selection benchmarks are DEVELOPMENT design evidence, not a fourth RQ.
Carry-forward is review-status transfer, not measured human time saving.
Approval rate alone is not semantic quality.
Do not claim exhaustive modelling of dynamic enum/option domains.
SUS is exploratory and not the main causal evidence of RQ3.
No DEVELOPMENT output may be relabelled as FORMAL evidence.
Report the correlated epistemic-dependency threat explicitly: Expert A contributes to independent RQ1/RQ2 references, RQ3 bank validation and primary blind RQ3 scoring.

For RQ1, preserve real-ERP irregularities: reachable screens without a visible page title use blank name plus 'title_status: absent'; generic 404 destinations are logged separately rather than treated as automatic FNs; stable menu-exposed parameterized functional views may be separate route-level screens even when one frontend component is reused.

For RQ2, account for every frozen RQ1 functional screen route exactly once as included or explicitly excluded; route is the semantic screen identity, title may be absent, and ChatGPT may structure Expert A statements but may not provide unconfirmed factual content.
FORMAL001 must be reported transparently as a stopped diagnostic/non-confirmatory attempt and must not be pooled with FORMAL002 confirmatory results.
For RQ1, POLICY_BLOCKED items are reported separately and are not technical false negatives in the primary TP/FP/FN metrics.
For RQ2, POLICY_BLOCKED screens are outside primary semantic denominators, while failures/timeouts/abstentions on otherwise eligible screens remain in the denominator.
Dashboard (/admin/home) remains RQ2-eligible despite its absent global visible title.
RQ3 FORMAL002 uses frozen query bank v2; bank v1 remains immutable historical lineage.

RQ1.question: ¿Con qué fidelidad, cobertura y trazabilidad puede Chat-CBMM adquirir conocimiento funcional estructural de una interfaz ERP dinámica respecto de una referencia humana independiente?

RQ2.question: ¿Qué calidad semántica alcanza la generación grounded antes y después del Human-in-the-Loop, y qué esfuerzo humano requiere convertir las propuestas en conocimiento autorizado?

RQ3.question: ¿Cómo cambia la calidad factual, el grounding, el comportamiento seguro y la latencia del asistente al añadir semántica HITL autorizada, un writer grounded y, secundariamente, expansión gobernada de grafo?

investigator_responsibilities: anonimización y aleatorización de resultados RQ3
investigator_restrictions: No redefinir referencias, answer keys ni criterios de corrección después de observar los resultados formales.
No utilizar datos FORMAL para volver a ajustar código, prompts, modelos, thresholds o reglas del sistema.

matching_contract.diagnostic_purpose: Separate route discovery from title/hierarchy disagreement without changing the frozen primary RQ1 outcome definition.
matching_contract.screen_hierarchy_primary_identity: normalized route + normalized parent module path + normalized in-screen title
matching_contract.screen_reference_name: Visible title/header inside the screen after opening it; not the navigation-menu label.

metric_operationalization.evidence_traceability: reported as a separate deterministic provenance audit; its audit contract must be frozen before the first FORMAL structural output is inspected
metric_operationalization.precision_recall_f1: computed exhaustively for module, screen and screen_hierarchy over the policy-eligible subset of the frozen independent structural reference; POLICY_BLOCKED items are reported separately

not_claimed: exhaustive coverage of all dynamic option/value domains

reference_scope_contract.primary_screen_unit: stable route-addressable functional view exposed as a navigation destination; not necessarily a unique frontend component

reachable_screen_without_visible_title.interpretation: A route can be correctly discovered while strict title identity disagrees; screen_route remains diagnostic, not primary.

secondary_scope_policy.promotion_to_formal_quantitative_metric_: a separately specified reference schema, matching rule, sampling manifest and scoring harness frozen before the first corresponding FORMAL output is inspected

policy_scope_contract.primary_rule: POLICY_BLOCKED items are outside primary TP/FP/FN because the acquisition policy deliberately forbids their collection. They are reported separately rather than treated as technical misses.
policy_scope_contract.unexpected_detection_rule: Detection under a blocked prefix is an acquisition-policy violation requiring explicit reporting.

rq2_design.interpretation_rule: Approval rate alone is not semantic accuracy and is not evidence of time saved.
